summary: The scalar decomposition and its weighted-simplex application are correct. The compactness and extreme-point representation arguments cover singleton and boundary cases. The perturbation preserves both means and log-concavity, including the exact nonnegative quadratic term at equality indices, so extreme components have at most one strict interior index. The cumulative tilted slice weights are strictly log-concave, their height subsequence is log-concave, and lifting with the unchanged kernels preserves the exact joint mixture and full mean. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
